data.name: Sharvikman
data.gender_notes: Sharvikman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharvikman is a compound name derived from Sanskrit words 'Sharva' and 'Kman'. Sharva is a name of Lord Shiva, the god of power, destruction, and regeneration. Kman means 'man', 'being', or 'person'. Together, Sharvikman can be interpreted as 'god of power and victory', 'powerful being', or 'victorious person'. The name Sharvikman carries the meaning “God of Power and Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvikman usually hope their child will grow to embody god of power and victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvikman is a powerful and sacred name that invokes the blessings of Lord Shiva, the destroyer and transformer of the universe. It signifies strength, courage, wisdom, and victory over challenges and adversities.
data.etymology: Sharvikman belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Power and Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvikman total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
